This crisis is characterized by rising prices for essential goods, a sharp decline in the national currency, ongoing regional tensions with Israel and the US, as well as long-standing sanctions imposed by the US and EU. Tehran Iran

articles.title: Liveblog:Krieg in Gaza: Grenzübergang Rafah für begrenzten Personenverkehr wieder geöffnet

articles.image_title: Krieg in Gaza: Ambulances stand at the border crossing on February 1, 2026 in Rafah, Egypt. The crossing has been completely nearly 20 months and the reopening was part of the ceasefire dea between Israel and Palestine.
